text:
sam: Quick sync — noticed a race where ArgoCD auto-sync runs right after a GH merge but Atlantis apply is still queued, resulting in drift. Anyone seen this?

yara: yup saw it on prod yesterday. ArgoCD pulled manifests before terraform created the ConfigMap, pod failed on startup. :grimacing:

kevin: can we gate merges on an Atlantis apply status? AFAIK atlantis doesn't create a standard GitHub status check out of the box.

ana: We can. Options: have Atlantis post a status check (via webhook), have a GH Action that waits for the Atlantis comment, or run `atlantis apply` from CI (not ideal).

infra-bot: heads up — our Atlantis (v0.20) posts comments like `Atlantis: applied` and includes a permalink. No builtin GH check though.

sam: Idea: flip ArgoCD auto-sync off for infra-managed apps, then add a GH Action that waits for the Atlantis apply comment and triggers ArgoCD sync via API once apply is done. Keeps terraform as single source-of-truth for infra updates.

yara: +1 to that. Also add a required branch protection check named `infra/atlantis-apply` so merges can't happen until GH Action verifies apply.

kevin: rough GH Actions step we could use (pseudo):
```
- name: Wait for Atlantis apply
  uses: actions/github-script@v6
  with:
    script: |
      const pr = context.payload.pull_request.number
      let applied = false
      for (let i=0; i<30; i++) {
        const comments = await github.rest.issues.listComments({owner, repo, issue_number: pr})
        if (comments.data.some(c => /Atlantis.*appl?ied/i.test(c.body))) { applied = true; break }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 10000))
      }
      if (!applied) core.setFailed('Atlantis apply not detected')
# then curl argocd api or use argocd/cli to sync app
```

ana: also consider using Atlantis global lock or state locking to prevent concurrent applies; that was another source of flakiness. And for secrets wiring: we use sealed-secrets so ArgoCD can apply k8s secrets after terraform writes secret metadata in the cluster. Document that in runbook.

deploy-bot: FYI I created a small reusable action `redwood/wait-for-atlantis` in a branch — it wraps the comment-poll + argocd-sync steps. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/.github/actions/wait-for-atlantis (draft) :eyes:

sam: perfect. I'll open a PR adding the workflow and flip the ArgoCD apps to manual sync for infra namespaces. @yara can you update the ArgoCD app config? @kevin can you add the branch protection check? :thumbsup:

yara: on it — I'll roll the ArgoCD change as a canary to one staging app first.

kevin: will add the branch protection after your PR is open so we can test end-to-end.

ana: I'll add a short section to the infra runbook describing the merge -> atlantis apply -> argocd sync ordering and the sealed-secrets pattern.

sam: thanks team. I'll post PR link here once it's up and tag you for review.
